units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 8:8">Targ. Jer. VIII, 8</cite> <he>למְזַיְּיפָא</he> ed. Lag. (ed. <he>לַזַיָּפָא</he>).—
<cite ref="Ketubot 36b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>זַיּוּפֵי ז׳ וכתב</he> he practiced imitation of handwriting and then wrote himself.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 163a:8">B. Bath. 163ᵃ</cite> <he>דילמא מְזַיֵּיף וכתב וכ׳</he> he may imitate and insert (over the signatures) whatever he desires.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 163a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>כל דמזייף לאו וכ׳</he> (not <he>המז׳</he>, v. Ms. M.) whoever desires to forge will not go to the scribe; a. e.
